description: This file defines the OpsWorksClient class for AWS SDK, providing methods to interact with AWS OpsWorks service, including synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: OpsWorksClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS OpsWorks service, extending AwsClient, with methods for various OpsWorks operations.
